rules.name: 开头清晰度
rules.description: 开头应快速建立场景与主题
rules.description_en: The opening should establish context and topic quickly.

rules.name: 结构连贯性
rules.description_en: The content should have a coherent structure.

rules.name: 人设一致性
rules.description_en: The voice should match the target persona.

rules.name: 表达自然度
rules.description: 避免机械和过度营销表达
rules.description_en: Avoid mechanical or overly promotional language.

rules.name: CTA 自然度
rules.description: 行动建议应自然且不过度承诺
rules.description_en: The call to action should feel natural and avoid overpromising.

rules.name: 图文一致性
rules.description: 正文事实应与图片证据一致
rules.description_en: Text claims should align with image evidence.
